conviction_note: The FY26 guide was already cut on 21 Oct (resultatvarsel-equivalent, stock -24% on its worst day ever) and the company promised 'further updates' at this print plus a strategy status update, so the move is large and lives in the guide. The evidence on direction is balanced: an apparent overshoot (about NOK 3.9bn of value lost against a NOK 300m EBITDA cut), local buyers (Astrup about NOK 40m, DNB AM above 5%) and capital recycling (EBRD platform, Dandara financing) on the up side. On the down side are a steadily building JPM AM short, an unquantified structural Philippines reserve-market hit, a likely Ukraine impairment and a name that has sold its last two guide cuts. So p_up is 52 on an abs move of 8.5, and impact_sum is +0.4.

already_public.what: FY2026 proportionate power-production EBITDA guide cut by NOK 300m to NOK 3,300-3,600m (from 3,600-3,900m): Ukraine attacks, Philippines reserve-market suspension, Mogobe BESS delay, Pakistan true-up delay, FX. Company 'continues to assess the financial implications' and will update at Q3 on 30 Oct

Q2 2026 outlook: Q3 power production 1,500-1,600 GWh, Q3 Philippines EBITDA NOK 320-420m, D&C margin 10-12%, corporate EBITDA NOK -125 to -135m, 2030 targets (NOK 1bn/yr equity growth investment, gross corporate debt to NOK 4bn, NOK 3.4bn divestments)
EBRD 60/40 Egypt platform, EBRD up to USD 221m (about USD 170m equity) for stakes in Obelisk, Shadwan, Dandara, Energy Valley
Dandara phase 1 (569 MW solar + 100 MWh BESS) financed: USD 217m non-recourse (80% of capex), NBE takes 20%, equity bridge loans to defer Scatec equity
Modular Finance consensus Q3 2026 (9 contributors, all updated or confirmed): proportionate power production EBITDA NOK 1,116m, D&C EBITDA 75.7m, total proportionate EBITDA 1,154m

new_in_release.expect: The 21 Oct release promised 'further updates': a breakdown of the NOK 300m cut, Q4 implied, and possibly a first 2027 view. A further narrowing to the low end is a real risk, and so is reassurance that the Philippines hit is temporary. Direction unknown, magnitude large

Strategy status update (per the 16 Oct invitation). Possibly progress on the NOK 3.4bn divestment target via the EBRD platform, or revised 2030 targets. Mildly positive on capital recycling, unknown on growth targets

Q3 power EBITDA against the post-warning 1,116m consensus. The Philippines reserve-market suspension took effect after quarter end (12 Oct), so Q3 Philippines (guided 320-420m) is largely spared. Roughly in line
A likely Ukraine impairment (country risk and long-term price outlook named in the warning), below EBITDA. Negative but expected
Working capital in Egypt construction (Q2 CFO -374m) and corporate net debt. Unknown
No dividend paid in recent periods; none expected

positioning_check: Finanstilsynet SSR (https://ssr.finanstilsynet.no/api/v2/instruments, as of 2026-10-27): 3.45% across 4 holders, up from 1.10% on 10-05 and 1.83% on 10-16, so building. findings.finding: The 22 Oct reaction (-23.9%, NOK 101.0 to 76.85, on 8.4m shares against about 0.4m normal; e24: worst trading day in the company's history) wiped about NOK 3.9bn off the equity (159.9m shares) for a NOK 300m cut to one year's EBITDA. That cut was about 8% of the old midpoint and partly FX, and an e24 analyst said the collapse 'should be used to buy', so the market priced a structural loss that the print can confirm or refute.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide cuts have been sold here: Q1 2026 (cut NOK 200m) -12.95%; the 21 Oct warning -23.9%. A guide raise (Q1 2025 'increasing growth outlook') +6.05%
findings.original_quote: Analytiker om Scatec-kollaps: – Bør benyttes til kjøp. Fornybarselskapet noterer sin verste børsdag noensinne etter resultatvarsel.
findings.why_not_priced: The +9.8% rebound off the 76.85 low (84.4 on 10-29) has retraced only about 30% of the fall. If the market agreed the cut was overdone, the stock would sit nearer the low-90s. The headline itself is paywalled (E24+), so the argument behind 'buy' is not in the wire copy

findings.finding: Since the warning, Scatec has signed the EBRD Egypt platform (EBRD about USD 170m equity for 40%) and financed Dandara phase 1 (USD 217m non-recourse, NBE 20%, equity bridge loans to defer Scatec's equity to the end of construction). These are capital-recycling and funding steps that answer the balance-sheet fear and feed the NOK 3.4bn divestment target the strategy update will report against.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Egypt deal news has lifted the stock before (E24 12 Jan 2026: 'steg markant etter å ha landet Egypt-avtale'). Q3 2025 'continuing to deleverage' +0.37%
findings.why_not_priced: Both were announced inside the post-crash week, the Dandara item at 18:46 CEST on 28 Oct. The implied valuation of the stakes sold to EBRD and the proceeds toward the divestment target are not disclosed. The strategy update is where they get quantified, so the market cannot yet price the deleveraging

findings.finding: The Q3 quarter itself should land near the post-warning bar. The Philippine ERC reserve-market suspension was approved 8 Oct and announced 12 Oct, after quarter end, so Q3 Philippines (guided NOK 320-420m) is largely untouched, and all 9 consensus contributors updated after the warning (power EBITDA 1,116m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 'solid' quarter +0.16%; Q3 2025 +0.37%. In-line quarters barely move this stock
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the consensus was rebuilt after the warning. It is filed because the quarter-end timing of the suspension is a checkable fact that bounds the Q3 downside

findings.finding: The Philippines hit is structural and still unquantified. ERC suspended the WESM reserve market indefinitely, with a six-month redesign 'to limit elevated prices'. NGCP will instead contract reserves at ASPA rates of about P5-6/kWh against Visayas reserve prices above P20/kWh, and the warning gave no number for SNAP, Scatec's largest EBITDA contributor.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A Philippines retroactive tariff gain lifted Q2 2025 (+2.33% reaction). The Philippines-led warning produced -23.9%
findings.why_not_priced: Most of it is likely priced in the 24% fall. The residual is that the release must quantify Q4 and 2027 Philippines exposure. NGCP's re-contracting within about 30 days, which sets the new ASPA rates, may already be partly known to the company. The transmission from industry rates to SNAP is an industry-to-company inference
findings.independence: Company confirms the suspension and redesign aim: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=684544

findings.finding: JPMorgan Asset Management (UK) has added to its short on every reported day from 0.60% (13 Oct) to 1.81% (27 Oct), through the warning and the rebound, taking disclosed shorts from 1.10% to 3.45%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior Qube 1.0% short (July 2026) was closed before Q2. No reaction link established
findings.why_not_priced: It is already in the baseline lean (short_building -2.0), so most of it is priced. It is filed small because the seller kept adding into the bounce, which a seller who thought the print would reassure would not do. At 3.45% it is not a crowded short

findings.finding: A Ukraine impairment is likely in the Q3 accounts. The warning names a worsened 'country risk assessment and longer-term power price outlook', which are impairment-test inputs, for 336 MW at 93% ownership, whose NOK 423m non-recourse debt was already in covenant breach at 30 June.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025 Mendubim NOK 130m impairment had no isolable reaction
findings.why_not_priced: It is non-cash, below EBITDA and widely anticipated after a 24% drop, so it is sized as a fraction of the same money at operating profit. A large write-down still hits the headline net loss and the EPS bar

'The move is in the guide' (9.0% median when guidance changes): abs_move_pct moved from 7.5 to 8.5, because the company promised further updates and a strategy status update
'One-off below operating income at a fraction': Ukraine impairment moved from -0.5 to -0.3
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not agree with': JPM AM short-building finding moved from -0.6 to -0.4, because it is already in the lean
'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': Philippines ASPA-rate finding moved from -0.8 to -0.6

'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus a name that sold its last two guide cuts: the overshoot finding moved from +0.8 to +0.6 and the Astrup/DNB finding from +0.5 to +0.4; p_up held at 52
